parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script has been localized into natural, code-mixed Bengali using the peer/friend register (tumi-tier). The characters have been re-cast to Sourav and Arnab from the Bengali casting table, and the hook opens entirely in native Bengali ('Dada, ek kilo chingri-r daam koto?') to maximize thumbstops. The multiplier '7x cheaper' was successfully localized to '7 gun sasta' per the T2h carve-out, and the language self-reference was swapped to 'Bangla-te' per T5. All other brand keywords and numerals remain correctly in English.

violations.quote: Ek maash-er modhyei visible progress dekhte pabe.
violations.why: The script guarantees a result within a month without using required hedge language like 'start to see' or 'can see'.
violations.fix: Change the script to 'Ek maash-er modhyei visible progress dekhte shuru korbe' to indicate the start of progress.

violations.why: The visual description contains an unapproved hard rupee price graphic ('1 RUPEE').
violations.fix: Remove the '1 RUPEE' graphic from the visual description.

safety.summary: The ad contains a severe claim guarantee violation in Scene 5 and an unapproved hard rupee price graphic in the Scene 5 visual.
